fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1A57300 zeroes 0x30 bytes in the set pattern (4-byte sizes at +0x1C and +0x2C). bg3.exe+0x1A56B80 (called from bg3.exe+0x1A56E10, ecl::timeline::ArenaTriggerSystem) clears it (memset of the bucket array to -1, sizes +0x1C/+0x2C = 0) and re-inserts with the 8-byte set insert bg3.exe+0x721030 every entity of a trigger query whose trigger object holds, in a HashSet<Guid> at +0x78, the timeline Guid taken from the first 16 bytes of the entity's ecl::timeline::TimelineLoadedComponent. The macOS function (anonymous)::UpdateTriggerReferences(WorldView<ecl::CinematicArenaTrigger const, ecl::timeline::ArenaTriggerHasPlayersComponent const, ecl::timeline::TimelineLoadedComponent const, ecl::timeline::ArenaComponent>&, ls::Guid, ls::HashSet<ls::ID<ecs::EntityHandleTraits>> ...) - the component's only writer per the macOS index - names the queried triggers (ecl::CinematicArenaTrigger) and the set type. Windows bg3.exe+0x1A56B80 clears the set at the start (memset buckets -1, sizes +0x1C/+0x2C = 0).
